description: This file is a Python script that sets up and runs a conversational bot pipeline for gathering user emails. It includes imports, environment setup, function definitions, configuration of various services (STT, TTS, LLM), pipeline assembly, and event handlers for client connections.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining functions that can be called within the LLM context.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema for managing available tools/functions for the LLM.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns using a local smart turn analysis approach.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection using Silero models.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Represents an execution frame for language model processing.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents a sequence of processing steps for the conversation pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles execution and management of the pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a task in the pipeline, including the pipeline and its params.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Contains context and tools for the LLM interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates context for LLM interactions, including user and assistant parts.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy to analyze and stop user turns.

classes.name: create_transport
classes.description: Function to create a transport based on runner arguments.

classes.name: main
classes.description: Main entry point for running the script.

methods.name: store_user_emails(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Asynchronous function that prints user emails argument, intended to store emails.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up and runs the conversational bot pipeline, including initializing services, configuration, and event handlers.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main bot entry point that creates the transport and starts the bot pipeline.
